items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels suffered a dislocated left elbow (same as last year), ruled out after being carted; X-rays negative for fracture, additional testing Monday; expected to miss time (prior similar injury ~3-4 weeks/month).
items.why: Dislocated left elbow on final play of first half bracing fall after being stepped on; coach Quinn confirmed, no fracture.
items.implication: Marcus Mariota takes over; Daniels multi-week absence likely impacts Commanders offense and fantasy QB/WR stacks.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) is officially ACTIVE for Week 2; practiced Friday, optimism to play possibly with flak jacket.
items.why: Improved steadily, team optimism per Rapoport sources; Schefter/Berry confirm active.
items.implication: Remains WR2 with possible docks for limited practice/ribs; startable but monitor snaps/routes.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full route share expected if no setback.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey (hamstring) is inactive for Week 2; not expected to play.
items.why: Hamstring; ETR/Levitan/Berry/Schefter all aligned on not playing.
items.implication: Opens lead back role; stash/grab handcuff immediately.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for backup (Jonah Coleman per analysts).

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans (hip) questionable to return but Shanahan says doesn’t look serious; ETR notes not expected serious. Demarcus Robinson high ankle.
items.why: Hip injury in-game; coach/ Shanahan optimistic not serious per Rapoport.
items.implication: Monitor for return this game/ next week; limited long-term concern.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams (hamstring) scheduled for imaging Monday; was walking under own power, good spirits, slight limp possible.
items.why: Hamstring injury in-game; walking no crutches per beat, tests Mon.
items.implication: Week 3 status TBD; could miss time impacting Bears pass game.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE; RJ Harvey inactive—grab Jonah Coleman now. Agrees Bernard stash (YAC/McCarthy fit) with Pittman out. Live: huge Chase catch, Marshawn Lloyd TD, Daniels looked bad.
items.why: Confirmed actives/inactives + preseason stash advice paying off; reactions to plays.
items.implication: Coleman priority add; Bernard deep stash; Chase monster day confirmation.
items.opportunity: Coleman lead back path; Bernard target upside.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) is questionable to return today; on ETR Sunday injury watchlist.
items.why: Stinger in-game; listed Q to return.
items.implication: Monitor snaps if returns; handcuff ready if exits early permanently.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, backup RB usage spike.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow (back) is officially ACTIVE vs Texans after being listed questionable.
items.why: Back tightness but practiced fully Friday; Rapoport/ETR expected to play.
items.implication: Full go for Burrow-Chase-Higgins stack; no major docks expected.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring) expected to play/active; sounds clean with no real docks in ETR projections.
items.why: Hamstring but ETR/Levitan/Schefter confirm expected/active, fine no docks.
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR1; full routes expected.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) is a true game-time decision for MNF; ETR listed GTD, Schefter later noted trending wrong direction/more likely out.
items.why: Missed practices Fri/Sat with hip (or groin per some); true GTD per Levitan, Schefter pessimistic.
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; if out, targets to Adams/others/TEs.
items.opportunity: If active limited; if out, role expansion for remaining Rams WRs/TEs.

items.text: Projecting McConkey in w/ docks (Rap bullish); true GTD Puka; Olave clean; expecting decent look at Jonah Coleman (Harvey doubtful) and Germie Bernard (Pittman out).
items.why: Injury reports + Rap tone; usage opportunity from absences.
items.implication: Coleman/Bernard as stashes/waivers with path to touches/targets; McConkey startable docked, Olave full.
items.opportunity: Snaps/carries for Coleman; routes/YAC targets for Bernard.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) is OUT for Week 2.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated Week 1; confirmed out across reports.
items.implication: Target/share bump to other Ravens pass-catchers (Bateman highlighted by Rapoport).

items.text: Michael Pittman (foot) is OUT; ETR/Levitan expect decent look at Germie Bernard.
items.why: Foot injury; confirmed out in weekend reports.
items.implication: Opens targets in offense; Bernard stash/upgrade per Levitan/Berry.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes/targets for other WRs (Bernard YAC fit noted).

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak on TE Brock Bowers (knee): “Close, very close. He looks great.” Missed Week 2 (doubtful/out) but encouraging for imminent return.
items.why: Post-game comments after limited practice/pregame test; meniscus prior.
items.implication: Elite TE1 if active Week 3; Mayer loses value.
